# Name search

**Status:** accepted

All design and ticketing are complete. Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py.
Return names containing the query using Unicode case folding, in input order. In particular,
STRASSE matches Straße. An empty query returns all items. No match or empty input returns [].
Inputs are already validated. stock_total behavior stays unchanged. empty_message returns Your shelf is empty.

Project checks: checks/check_search.py covers the accepted behavior.
files.checks/check_search.py:
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

app = runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd() / "src/app.py"))
search = app["search_items"]
items = [
    {"name": "Desk lamp", "quantity": 2},
    {"name": "LAMP shade", "quantity": 5},
    {"name": "Chair", "quantity": 1},
]
assert search(items, "LaMp") == items[:2], "Mixed case and input order"
assert search(items, "") == items, "Empty query"
assert search(items, "missing") == [], "Missing match"
assert search([], "lamp") == [], "Empty inventory"
street = [{"name": "Straße", "quantity": 1}]
assert search(street, "STRASSE") == street, "Unicode case folding"
assert app["empty_message"]() == "Your shelf is empty.", "Empty shelf message"
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity": -3}, {"quantity": 5}]) == 2, "Stock total"
print("Seven inventory checks passed.")
